\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{pgfplots}
\pgfplotsset{compat=1.18}
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \begin{loglogaxis}[
    width=9cm,
    height=7cm,
    xmin=0.01,
    xmax=100,
    ymin=0.0001,
    ymax=10000,
    grid=both,
    xlabel={$x$},
    ylabel={$x^2$}
  ]
    \addplot[red,very thick,mark=square*] coordinates {
      (0.01,0.0001) (0.1,0.01) (1,1) (10,100) (100,10000)
    };
  \end{loglogaxis}
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
